description: Suggests a product for our agent to drive and list (free, anyone, any product). It is a signal for our planner, never a promise or a place in the queue: we pick by demand and gaps. A product listed already answers with its listing and the date its next drive is due (listed.next_drive_by). With an email, we write once when its listing is live.

email.description: Optional: your address, for one email when its listing is live
